future_assay_decision: A separate versioned panel review must choose whether to retain S1022 and describe/size the trnV-to-atpB span including atpE, or redesign an atpE-bounded spacer assay. Do not silently rename, broaden bounds, or replace oligos in this frozen evaluation.
limitations: Circular public-source Hamming mapping is not a wet-lab binding prediction or a simulation of the graph assembler.
Negative results in this bounded catalog do not establish biological absence or prove every shorter hypothesis false.
Public plastomes represent independent reference individuals, not confirmed sample haplotypes.

physical_assay_interpretation: trnV-UAC to atpB, spanning the complete intervening atpE gene; configured reverse endpoint is within atpB, not atpE.
publication_interpretation: The historical locus name and this configured primer combination are not a sufficient description of physical endpoints. Independent primer literature and three public feature tables agree on the atpB endpoint.
release_interpretation: Retain the emitted records as uncertain hypotheses under the frozen interface. Do not count them as validated target recovery. The configured canonical-plastome assay lies outside the current length bound; a production graph can still produce shorter strings through other paths.
